# Steps `dev/ci_contract.py` permits to name a tool, and the reason each does.
#
# An entry is `workflow.yml:Step name`. Every line is a debt with an owner, not
# a dispensation: the file exists so the unconverted surface is a number
# someone can burn down instead of a silence.
#
# THE GROUPS BELOW ARE THE BURNDOWN ORDER, cheapest and most duplicated first.

# --- runner-plane - belongs to the shared runner preflight ---------------------
# `dev.ci.runner_queue_watchdog` is this repository's own implementation of a
# check the shared runner preflight owns; replacing it with the rendered copy
# retires this entry.
release.yml:Fail fast on a lane no online runner can serve

# --- CI-plane bookkeeping ------------------------------------------------------
# Reads and writes GitHub state through `gh`, `git` or the release automation,
# or reports a job verdict, and has no local meaning; `gh` is already permitted
# and these differ only in reaching it through a shell conditional.
merge-gate.yml:Require every gate job to succeed
merge-gate.yml:Refuse fork pull requests
release-please.yml:Regenerate uv.lock on the release branch
release-please.yml:Push the regenerated uv.lock onto the release branch
release-please.yml:Reconcile uv.lock with the released version
release-please.yml:Open a reconciling pull request when the lockfile drifted
release-please.yml:Dispatch release proof for the release pull request
release-please.yml:Dispatch release publication
release-please.yml:Refuse a deadlocked release state
release.yml:Require every prove job to succeed
release.yml:Locate the successful prove run for this version and commit
release.yml:Require the tap token
release.yml:Require the bucket repository and token
release.yml:Stage the formula unless the tap already serves it
release.yml:Push the formula to the tap
release.yml:Stage the manifest unless the bucket already serves it
release.yml:Push the manifest to the bucket
release.yml:Require the deploy role before anything else
release.yml:Alert on failure without touching the release
release.yml:Report an already published version

# --- pending - a gate with no recipe -------------------------------------------
# Each is a real gate that a contributor cannot run before pushing.
#   test-live-drift        the GROI live-drift suite, named by path
aeat-drift-detector.yml:Run GROI live drift tests
aeat-corpus-staleness.yml:Compare the captured corpus against the official pages
aeat-corpus-staleness.yml:Fail the run only when the corpus has drifted
release.yml:Packaging performance contracts
release.yml:Future-directive policy
release.yml:Emit the prerelease runtime row
release.yml:Emit the stable runtime smoke matrix
release.yml:Read the interpreter pin

# --- pending - the release lane ------------------------------------------------
# Cohort build, sealing, channel acquisition and publication steps, none of
# them runnable by a developer. Recipes needed: `release-build-cohort`,
# `release-verify-cohort`, `release-publish-pypi`, `packaging-evidence`,
# `test-channel-homebrew`, `test-channel-scoop`, `release-reacquire`.
release.yml:Refuse a burned or mismatched version
release.yml:Build the immutable release cohort
release.yml:Refuse a distribution over the index file cap
release.yml:Seal the release cohort
release.yml:Extract and verify the sealed release cohort
release.yml:Extract and verify the proven release cohort
release.yml:Extract the proven release cohort
release.yml:Verify the seal, version and tag
release.yml:Install the cohort, run installed oracles, emit the row
release.yml:Packaging campaign against the sealed cohort
release.yml:Checkpoint packaging evidence
release.yml:Smoke test the built wheels
release.yml:Initialize current-run evidence root
release.yml:Verify declared Homebrew release row
release.yml:Audit install and exercise the cohort's own formula
release.yml:Emit the Homebrew distribution-evidence record
release.yml:Clean up the retained Homebrew install
release.yml:Stage the Homebrew evidence bundle
release.yml:Verify declared Windows native release row
release.yml:Stage token-free smoke harness
release.yml:Install and exercise the cohort's own manifest
release.yml:Verify the smoke evidence binds to this cohort
release.yml:Emit the Scoop distribution-evidence record
release.yml:Select the sealed distribution bytes
release.yml:Compare the sealed bytes with the package index
release.yml:Refuse a version any destination already owns
release.yml:Publish to PyPI
release.yml:Publish the documentation site
release.yml:Reacquire the cohort from PyPI
release.yml:Reacquire the cohort from the public tap
release.yml:Reacquire the cohort from the public bucket
